answers.q: Which store owes me the most?
answers.a: Pomegranate in Flatbush and The Grove in Boca, $1,065.60 each. Pomegranate's oldest invoice is 63 days. Stores owe $14,401.44 in total, $3,214.08 of it past 60 days.

answers.q: Which channel makes me the most per bag?
answers.a: The site. A 1st Cut Brisket bag clears $5.92 there after shipping and fees, $5.83 on subscription, $2.30 in a store and $1.60 wholesale.
Six of eight store tastings lifted that store's next 4 weeks. Evergreen Lakewood, Gourmet Glatt Jackson and Cedar Market Teaneck were up more than 50%. Kosher West was flat, so skip a repeat there.

answers.q: Did I make money in September?
answers.a: Yes, $4,430.43 on $55,530.64 of sales (8%). Shipping on free-shipping orders cost $4,863, more than ads.
